summary: A user attempting to transfer 1200 dollars to a Bybit wallet copied the correct deposit address into MetaMask but malware on the device replaced the pasted address with an attacker controlled wallet. The victim discovered the substitution only after the deposit never arrived.
user_mistake: Confirmed a crypto transfer without verifying the pasted wallet address
prevention: Verify pasted wallet addresses before confirming transactions/Scan devices for clipboard malware before handling crypto transfers
